evidence: Films were deposited in a commercial flow-type F-120 Sat reactor from ASM Microchemistry. Alternating pulses of the precursors were introduced into the reactor chamber separated by purging with N2 gas (claimed purity >99.999%) produced with an N2 generator (Nitrox 3001). Nitrogen was also used as a carrier gas. The iron and cobalt sources were Fe(thd)3 and Co(thd)2 synthesized from FeCl3 (99.0%, Fluka), CoCl2·6H2O( ≥98%, Fluka), and Hthd (2,2,6,6-tetramethylheptane-3,5-dione; 98%, Fluka) as described in ref. 27. Ozone was supplied from an OT-020 ozone generator (Ozone Technology) using oxygen (AGA, purity >99.999%) as input.
